applicationBlocked.title: FAQ: Why can’t I apply to a race?
applicationBlocked.subtitle: Common application blockers.
applicationBlocked.overview: A race application can be blocked by the race status, deadlines, capacity or eligibility.
details: Applications may not be open yet.
The race may be active, finished or cancelled.
Your team may not match entry requirements.
You may already have an application/entry.
tips: Open Race Detail and check entry rules.

acceptedNotReady.title: FAQ: Why am I accepted but not ready?
acceptedNotReady.subtitle: Accepted entry is not a complete race plan.
acceptedNotReady.overview: Accepted means your team has a place; ready means riders, staff, assets, equipment, supplies and stage plans are usable.
details: Race Plan still needs to be submitted.
Stage Plans may still be missing.
Deadlines may lock changes if missed.
tips: Open Race Preparation after every accepted race.

riderUnderperformed.title: FAQ: Why did my rider underperform?
riderUnderperformed.subtitle: Performance has many causes.
riderUnderperformed.overview: A strong rider can perform badly if the role, stage, condition, tactics or support were wrong.
details: Check if the rider skills matched the terrain.
tips: Use replay and commentary to learn.

money.title: FAQ: Where did my money go?
money.subtitle: How to investigate balance changes.
money.overview: Finance Transactions is the source for balance movements.
details: Review salaries, tax, sponsor payments, transfers, equipment, infrastructure, camps and policies.
Open Team Policies for recurring cost.
Remember that loans are debt, not income.
tips: Transactions is the first page for finance questions.

equipment.title: FAQ: Why is my equipment bonus small?
equipment.subtitle: Bonus caps and trade-offs.
equipment.overview: Equipment is weighted and capped so it supports but does not replace rider quality.
details: Specialist gear can have negative trade-offs.
tips: Use the right setup for the right stage.

staffHiring.title: FAQ: Why can’t I hire staff?
staffHiring.subtitle: Common hiring blockers.
staffHiring.overview: Staff hiring depends on role capacity, availability and money.
details: Check open slots for the role.
Upgrade infrastructure if capacity is full.
Check whether the role is unlocked by facilities.
tips: Capacity problems usually point to Infrastructure.
